title: Data Cabling Engineer
description:
Data Cabling Engineer


Swindon


Permanent - Full-time


8 hour shift, Overtime, Night shift, Monday – Friday


We are currently recruiting for a Data Cabling Engineer to join our client based in Swindon to work with the installations and planning department.


The Role:

  • Work from construction drawings, reading job diagrams, scopes, and specifications.
  • Installations of network and structured cabling (Cat5/5e/6 & Fibre)
  • Termination of cables on patch panels and modules
  • Testing with Fluke Testers
  • Maintaining Quality standards whilst meeting agreed timescales
  • Reporting on progress and issues affecting the work
  • Working safely at all times in accordance with Health & Safety policies
  • Diagnose and rectify faults.
  • Interacting with clients


The Requirements:

  • 5+ Years' experience within installation of telecommunications
  • Installation of structured cabling systems
  • Working knowledge of CCTV and door access (not essential but desirable)
  • Ability to carry out basic Fluke testing of copper Cat5/6 & Fibre
  • Have flexibility around working hours, including night work and overtime
  • Willing to work within different locations over the UK including staying away
  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently under pressure paying good attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and able to take initiative, self-manage workload without supervision
  • CSCS (or equivalent)
  • Driving license


The Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Company pension
  • Company van
  • Excellent overtime rates
  • Annual leave plus public holidays
  • On-going training and career progression
  • Social events
  • Sick pay
